title: The GRADIEND Python Package: An End-to-End System for Gradient-Based Feature Learning
measurement_description: The paper measures the proportional overlap of the Top-k most affected parameters in a language model's weight space for learned feature directions related to religious groups (Christian/Jewish/Muslim). This aims to quantify similarity between features and identify partially shared parameters associated with societal bias across different feature families.
findings: The analysis revealed that race and religion features show comparatively larger overlap (up to ≈ 17%) in the model's parameter space, suggesting partially shared parameters associated with societal bias. In contrast, cross-group overlap was generally small, and grammatical number and person were encoded largely disjointly.
